drafted_from: tool:measure-how-a-show-stages-a-characters-turns's row in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/do-work/ and the tests in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/test/
start_here: Say to your AI: "Measure how the show stages the parrot's turns in vid-a: cuts, shot lengths and music stop-downs." It runs tool:measure-how-a-show-stages-a-characters-turns and updates staging.tsv.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads one settings row of yours (record:setting:measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging~<scope_kind>~<scope_id>) or the settings you pass, and works on files in the show's folder.
instructions: 1. Make the show's folder and the YouTube library folder the run may change, and have voice/<id>.turns.json (tool:find-when-a-character-speaks), measure/<id>/rhythm.json and measure/<id>/earshot-timeline.txt for each id in the youtube folder. Put the keys the row needs (none: it reads no settings key) in your settings row or pass them as settings.

2. Say the sentence in start_here to your AI. It calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:measure-how-a-show-stages-a-characters-turns and the input in the worked example; the door asks for the granted folder.
3. Read the last line it prints, {"result": ...}, or {"error": ...} saying what to fix (a missing settings key is named).
4. Read staging.tsv: each share is set beside its share by chance, so a cut at entry far above chance means the show stages the character's turns with a cut.

worked_examples.title: Staging of one episode with three turns
worked_examples.ask: How does the show stage the parrot in vid-a?
worked_examples.given: From the sample run in tools/measure-a-characters-voice-lines-and-staging/tool-rows.json: vid-a has turns [10,12], [15,17] and [40,42] (6.0 s), shots 0-9.8, 9.8-11.0, 11.0-30.0 and 30.0-60.0 at 4 cuts a minute, and one music stop-down at 0:08.50.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result": {"table": "{grant:change-a-folder}/show/staging.tsv", "measured": ["vid-a"]}}; the vid-a row is turns 3, character_s 6.0, cut_at_entry_share 0.33 against cut_chance_share 0.05, median_shot_in_exchange_s 10.1 against median_shot_elsewhere_s 19.9, stopdown_before_turn_share 0.33 against stopdown_chance_share 0.03.
